title: Build a tiny PageRank-style chain
description: You combine link transitions with uniform jumps and inspect stationary probabilities.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You distribute each node's transition probability over its outgoing links. A node with no outgoing links instead receives a uniform transition row.
You mix the link matrix with uniform matrix J. alpha gives the link matrix its weight, and J receives the remaining weight.

steps.question: Which supplied node takes the no-outgoing-links branch?
steps.answer: Node 4 has an empty adjacency list. Its link transition row is uniform over all five nodes.

steps.description: You confirm that all row sums are one and compute the stationary distribution. The recording assigns node 2 the largest probability, which the final bar chart displays.
